summary: Cline's September 24, 2026 announcement says Gemini 3.8 Flash is free in Cline, citing 1M context, ~291 tok/s, and Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score 41. Official free-models docs say free promotions are available to any user with a Cline account, provide a limited usage quota, rotate over time, and work in the Cline IDE extension and CLI—not the Cline API. No fixed end date is published, so this listing uses a null expiry date to mean no announced end date, not permanent availability.
claim_steps: Install the Cline IDE extension from the marketplace, or install the CLI with: npm install -g cline.
Sign in with a Cline account (IDE settings → API Provider Cline → Sign In, or run: cline auth).
In the model selector, look for Gemini 3.8 Flash tagged FREE under the Cline (usage-billing) provider; during promotional periods it may also appear under ClinePass.
Use it in the Cline IDE extension or CLI within the limited free quota; free models are not available through the Cline API.

Gemini 3.8 Flash is free in Cline.

It scores 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, the highest of any model in its price tier. 291 tok/s, 1M context, and it beats GPT-5.6 Luna, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, and Qwen3.8 on benchmarks.

social_proof.title: Cline Free Models - Cline
social_proof.text: Cline periodically offers free model promotions that let you try select models at no cost, up to a limited usage quota. Free model promotions are offered on a rotating, limited-time basis. Free models are available to any user with a Cline account. Free model usage is not supported through the Cline API. Free models are only available in the Cline IDE Extension and CLI.

social_proof.title: Installing Cline - Cline
social_proof.text: Install the CLI with npm install -g cline, then authenticate with cline auth. IDE users install the Cline extension and authorize in settings.

social_proof.title: Authorization - Cline
social_proof.text: Cline (usage-billing) (recommended): sign in with Google/GitHub/email, no API key setup. Built-in billing and free model options.
